phases.title: Fix debounce wiring in FilterContext: use 300ms delay with immediate clear
phases.notes: In src/benchmark-frontend/src/context/FilterContext.tsx line 51, change `useDebounce(search, 0)` to `useDebounce(search, search === '' ? 0 : 300)`. This fixes both bugs: (1) real 300ms debounce on typing, (2) instant reset when search is cleared. No changes to useDebounce.ts or useFilteredProducts.ts are needed.
